subject: Texture readiness review: six unresolved correctness cases; ABI not frozen
body: Ready-for-review inspected CURRENT production header, and several prior concrete findings remain UNFIXED, so helper ABI is not frozen yet. Blocking: (1) lines352..355 formats180..183 ETC2RGB8/RGB8A1 still bytes_per_block16; must8 (pinned u_format.yaml X64). Current test only178RGBA8 does not cover this. (2) swizzle_word0 still meansdefault, silently prevents valid MaliRRRR; highbits outside12 also not rejected. Use explicit sentinel/validity, test RRRR and bit12. (3) pack_layout rejects address0 but accepts backing_length0; layout_check then skips span/end48bit checks. Public pack must require nonzero bounded span; test zero-length and aligned VA>=2^48. (4) Cube kind5 now permits any multiple6 layers and nonsquare dimensions; ordinaryCube mustexact6 and square. (5) first_layer still validated but not applied; current comment calls physicalbase. Choose explicit convention: resolvedbase/offsets already view-adjusted, first_layer informational, OR addstride exactlyonce. Test nonzero first_layer with distinguishable addresses; first_level too. (6) nord2_metal_render.h still wrongly says addresses.binding[binding]; actual index is requestPOSITION i. (7) n2r_validate_v2 returns only gd_request_ok with global trcount flag; it does not validate version/duplicates/orphans or sidecar layout itself, so cannot promise authoritative preflight. Build checks some later; document or share proper preflight. I see clump and diagnosticNUL fixed, orphancheck now present. Lastly your new message says compute storage table3: CORRECTION final lowererACK is table1[N] texture/image,table2[N]sampler,internal2[256]. Do not restate supersededproposal. Required tests should derive these missing cases independently, not only current positivewordpack. No build by audit.
